scope: Read-only current export algorithm review; no source/SKD/app/build execution or shared mutations.
observed_algorithm: Default export captures all selected source bytes/modes and indexed absence before copy.
Every copy rechecks exact bytes/size/mode against that initial capture.
A complete second source capture and excluded-fixture/indexed-absence comparison rejects drift.
Final candidate verification again compares the exact exported payload to current source.
Retain-source-drift mode is explicitly weaker and is not selected by the native consumer commands.
proposed_followup: A separately sealed controller derivative can replace its claim of an exclusive coordinated source hold with explicit required strict-source comparison and isolated candidate ownership, keeping the exact exporter SHA, zero-drift mode, successful predecessor/export receipt pins and all busy/tamper guards. Existing immutable controller/admissions remain unchanged.
evidence_limits: These fences verify observed byte/mode equivalence across capture/copy/readback. They do not prove an OS exclusive source lock or absence of transient write-and-restore activity between captures.
